title: oil stocks us strategic petroleum reserve fall by 12 million barrels lowest 2026 09 08
text:
Sept 8 (Reuters) - Stocks of crude oil ​in the ‌U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell ​by ​about 1.2 million barrels ⁠to 285.4 ​million barrels ​last week, the lowest level since ​November 1982, ​according to data from ‌the ⁠Department of Energy.
The drawdowns are part ​of ​a ⁠U.S. agreement to ​release 172 ​million ⁠barrels from the facility.
